positiveEvidence: A fixed-point upright capsule sweep against flat authored terrain returns the first face contact distance, point and upward normal.
A horizontal sweep resolves contact from the capsule segment interior against an authored triangle edge, not only from an endpoint sphere cap.
A lowered Large World terrain chunk reaches the same upright-capsule-vs-authored-triangle sweep path and returns a rooted terrain fixture hit.
Unsupported arbitrary shape casts remain fail-closed through the existing SPATIAL_SHAPE_CAST_UNSUPPORTED guard.
negativeEvidence: The implementation is bounded to upright capsules, unrotated static or fixed-rotation kinematic heightfields, and a maximum projected sweep window of 4096 cells.

This is a query candidate and does not replace the existing single-support/AABB terrain collision solver; dynamic terrain, arbitrary capsule rotation, box/convex terrain sweeps and complete contact manifolds remain open.
No dynamic terrain provider, physical device, target GPU frame-rate, Android, external network or production terrain deployment evidence exists.
